jezero-crater.comparison_summary: MISSION ABORT PREVENTED: Direct trajectory is NON-SURVIVABLE due to extreme slopes (peak 19.1 deg) and hazardous regolith corridors. The Safe Survival Path detoured around impassable crater scarps and Séítah sand dunes, limiting peak incline to 12.3 deg. Tradeoff: Detour adds 2.54 km (+30.5%) and requires an estimated 76.6 minutes of EVA traverse time to guarantee 100% crew and rover survival. OPERATIONAL VERDICT: EXECUTE SAFE SURVIVAL PATHWAY.

gale-crater.comparison_summary: 2025 BOXWORK ASCENT APPROVED: Direct ascent encounters a 23.4° sheer debris scarp at Gediz Vallis channel. The Safe Survival Path contours along the sulfate-bearing layered ridge switchbacks, keeping incline strictly under 11.6° to guarantee safe vehicle climbing to the 2025 subterranean boxwork fracture veins.

valles-marineris.comparison_summary: CANYON DESCENT SAFEGUARD: Direct vector plunges over a 38.6° fatal vertical cliff. Safe Survival Path follows an ancient natural landslide terrace switchback, descending from -2,100m to -5,800m at a stable 13.5° maximum gradient.

arcadia-planitia.comparison_summary: ISRU ICE EXTRACTION ROUTE: Direct line crosses hazardous thermokarst polygons with hidden sublimation voids. ares-vallis.comparison_summary: MEGAFLOOD CHANNEL ROUTE: Direct vector is obstructed by dense clusters of catastrophic flood boulders (>1.2m diameter). Safe Path utilizes smooth catastrophic gravel outflow terraces, reducing peak slope to 8.1° and preserving rover wheel integrity.

chryse-planitia.comparison_summary: VIKING BASIN ROUTE: Direct vector enters thick soft dust drift depressions with high wheel entrapment risk. Safe Path tracks along firm volcanic basalt pavement with peak slope of just 4.8°.

elysium-planitia.comparison_summary: SEISMIC CREVICE SAFEGUARD: Direct path crosses loose impact ejecta pit and active fault scarps. The Safe A* Path follows compact volcanic plains keeping incline below 6.4° and avoiding tremor crevasse hazards.
